LOG_COMP_BITMASK.DisplayName:
Enables Debug mode for the VGM, which saves logs on the SD Card

0: do not save any logs;
1: textual logs of the algorithm onboard;
2: MavLink messages as well as control reference values;
4: record video from frontal camera;
8: record video from navigation camera.

Parameter is configured as bitmask to allow multiple choices, [more information here](initial-setup/vgm-configuration#log_bitmask)
LOG_COMP_BITMASK.Description:
Enables Debug mode for the VGM, which saves logs on the SD Card

0: do not save any logs;
1: textual logs of the algorithm onboard;
2: MavLink messages as well as control reference values;
4: record video from frontal camera;
8: record video from navigation camera.

Parameter is configured as bitmask to allow multiple choices, [more information here](initial-setup/vgm-configuration#log_bitmask)

Bitmask.0: Textual logs of the algorithm onboard
Bitmask.1: MavLink messages as well as control reference values

LOG_CLEAN.DisplayName:
Triggers logs clean-up on the next boot when set to 1.

After logs clean-up is done it's reset to 0 automatically.

[More information here](initial-setup/vgm-configuration#clean-up)
LOG_CLEAN.Description:

LOG_SEC_BITMASK.DisplayName:
Enables Encrypted logging mode for the VGM, which saves all the logs into the `log.sec` on the SD Card

0: do not save any logs encrypted (use plain logs insead of encrypted ones);
1: save all the logs encrypted into `log.sec`;
2: use source of high entropy when creating `log.sec` for storing logs;
4: initialize `log.sec` w/ integrity check.

Parameter is configured as bitmask to allow multiple choices.

[More information here](initial-setup/vgm-configuration#log_sec_bitmask)
LOG_SEC_BITMASK.Description:

Parameter is configured as bitmask to allow multiple choices.

[More information here](initial-setup/vgm-configuration#log_sec_bitmask)

Bitmask.0: Save all the logs encrypted into `log.sec`
